remarks: Beautiful totally redone 3BR 2 Bath Ranch set on lovely level property. Conveniently located near the Merritt Parkway and shopping, this house has a new roof and new driveway. New electric. New kitchen features brand new appliances. Great open flow. Living Room with fireplace. Primary Bedroom with extra large walk in closet and en-suite bath. 2 additional bedrooms plus hall bath. Freshly painted, new Hardwood Floors, Recessed lighting, Central A/C and Full Attic for storage. House is energy efficient and has Spray foam insulation which keeps heating costs down. Full finished high ceiling basement with plumbing in place for another bathroom. 1 Car Detached Garage. Ready to just move in! ALSO AVAILABLE FOR RENT
